ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious File Write to SharePoint Layouts Directory
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects suspicious file writes to SharePoint layouts directory which could indicate webshell activity or post-exploitation.
This behavior has been observed in the exploitation of SharePoint vulnerabilities such as CVE-2025-49704, CVE-2025-49706 or CVE-2025-53770.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\w3wp\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Shared\\\\Web\\ Server\\ Extensions\\\\") OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Shared\\\\Web\\ Server\\ Extensions\\\\")) AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\15\\\\TEMPLATE\\\\LAYOUTS\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\16\\\\TEMPLATE\\\\LAYOUTS\\\\.*")) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.asax$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ascx$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ashx$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.asmx$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.asp$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.aspx$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.cmd$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.cer$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.config$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.js$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.jsp$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.jspx$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.php$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbs$")))
